name: Create Medication Request
description: Prescribe a medication for the current patient by selecting from the formulary or searching by RxNorm code, specifying dosage instructions, dispensing details, and the requesting practitioner.

intent_examples: Order a medication for the patient
when_to_use: User wants to prescribe or order a medication for a patient
User wants to create a FHIR MedicationRequest
User wants to write a prescription with dosage and dispensing instructions
when_not_to_use: User wants to order a procedure or lab (use create_service_request instead)
User wants to request a device (use create_device_request instead)
User wants to record an immunization (use record_immunization instead)
User wants to view existing medication orders

introduction: I'll help you create a medication prescription. Select or search for the medication, then fill in the dosage and dispensing details.

completion.message: Medication request created successfully. The prescription has been recorded in the patient's FHIR record.

workflow_steps.name: Prescribe Medication
workflow_steps.description: Select a medication from the formulary or search by RxNorm, add dosage instructions and dispensing details.

context_resolvers.description: Resolve the logged-in user's Patient record so patient_id is available automatically.

Fetch allowed intent codes for MedicationRequest.
